summary: Operator's site (rates also in the 2026-04-14 Wayback capture): $40/night full hookup for 2 people plus metered electric ($0.30/kWh), cash/check, $40 deposit via availability request form. Changed sites count 30 -> 46 (all pull-through, added), cleared note-derived max_rig_ft 60 (not stated). Added 50 A, fees, booking note, wifi/dump/camp store, season note. Under the US$50 gate before metered electric (no gateway within 40 km; nearest Lake George 58 km; family has not stayed). Presence fine: website with phone, Google Maps 4.7 from 79 reviews. No Good Sam/Passport/military stated. Note trimmed.
flags: Price gate, borderline: base $40/night plus metered electric at $0.30/kWh (a mandatory usage charge whose nightly amount is not posted); under US$50 unless a night uses ~33 kWh. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Lake George 58 km); the family has not stayed here.
